title: Dance execution protocol Steps 0-6 (registry check, extract, hear, seed+fruit, tune, build, deliver)
what: Step 0 registry check (27 dances listed). Step 1 extract: librosa 11 arrays, trim hits below 400, downsample to 1.0 s when song >300 s; read character: Arc (energy every 10 s: staircase, bellows, continuous, two-bloom, resurrection), Peak % (early = body first; late = consciousness last), Band weights (bass-heavy → Gaia leads), Drops (several = EDM), Quiet regions (more → more Karishma), Duration >300 s downsample. What is this song orbiting?'; instrumental: 'The absence of words IS the message.' Step 3 seed = one standalone question; fruit 2-4 sentences with {w}: 'acknowledge the offering → mirror what happened → inversion/reframe'. Step 4 tune binduHue, peakT, label, audio, colours, shapes, returnStart. Step 5 build: one template, 'Only arrays + config change.', 24 V1 + 8 V2 preservation checklist, <65 KB. Step 6 deliver: update registry.

title: analyze_tone.py: Krumhansl-Schmuckler key, absent-fifth candidate scoring (0.4·absence + 0.6·sweet), beat heuristic, default carrier 136.0
what: librosa 22050 Hz mono. chroma_cqt mean → dominant pitch class. KS profiles major [6.35,2.23,3.48,2.33,4.38,4.09,2.52,5.19,2.39,3.66,2.29,2.88], minor [6.33,2.68,3.52,5.38,2.60,3.53,2.54,4.75,3.98,2.69,3.34,3.17]; best roll → key, mode, confidence. Spectral centroid. STFT band energy sub-bass 20-80, bass 80-250, low-mid 250-500 Hz. Candidates note_freq(idx, oct) = 16.3516·2^oct·2^(idx/12) octaves 1-5 within 60-250 Hz; presence = local bin / max bin, absence = 1−presence, sweet = clamp(1−|f−140|/100); score 0.4·absence + 0.6·sweet. Beat: tempo <80 or rms_var <0.5 → 4 Hz theta; tempo <110 → 6 Hz theta-alpha; else 8 Hz alpha. Output {key, key_confidence, dominant_pitch, tempo_bpm, spectral_centroid, sub_bass_pct, bass_pct, carrier_hz, beat_hz, beat_label, binaural_left=carrier, binaural_right=carrier+beat}; default carrier 136.0. Batch runbook ignores prescription, reads absent fifth off candidate table.
how: Run on any recording Ashrey adds (temple recording, bell) to find its absent fifth.

title: temporal_analysis.py: bass-coverage verdict STRONG/MODERATE/SPARSE/ABSENT; STABLE vs MOVING carrier
what: STFT n_fft 2048 ('matches our Web Audio analyser.fftSize'), hop 512 (~43 fps). Dominant bin 50-300 Hz (threshold 0.01), 5 s windows {time, bass_hz, note, energy, bass_present_pct}; bass coverage %, note histogram, gaps >1 s. >80% STRONG; >50 MODERATE (needs fallback); >20 SPARSE ('pre-computed carrier recommended'); else ABSENT. std <30 Hz STABLE ('a fixed carrier at median would work'); else MOVING.

title: deep_analysis.py: binaural-pair detection, stereo width per band, isochronic pulse detection
what: soundfile chunked. Six 20 s L/R windows → FFT n=16384 Hann → top peaks 80-300 Hz per channel. Binaural pairs: L/R peaks 0.3 ≤ Δ ≤ 40 Hz in bands 20-80, 80-300, 300-800, labelled ≤1 delta, ≤4 theta, ≤8 alpha, ≤13 beta-low, ≤30 beta, else gamma. Stereo width: 45 s window at 35%, Butterworth bandpass, L/R corr, width = 1−|corr|; corr >0.97 MONO, >0.85 near-mono, width >0.25 stereo. Isochronic: 80-300 Hz bandpass → Hilbert envelope → ~200 Hz → FFT of envelope 1-40 Hz; peaks ≥0.18 consistent in ≥2 of 3 sections (25/50/70%). Mono files get isochronic check only.
how: Stereo check: corr >0.95 safe to add binaural.

title: G0 hold engine: commit on threshold, act on release, drain on early release; held-key parity; durations catalogue 700-5000 ms; bands; haptic ramp 0.15→0.6; accessibility
what: tick: dt=min(64,t−last); p += target>p ? dt/UP_MS : −dt/DOWN_MS (clamp); p≥1 && !locked → locked=true; onCommit(); p==0 && target==0 → stop. press(): target=1 (pointerdown, or keydown Enter/Space; e.repeat ignored). release(): locked&&!done → done=true; onComplete(); else target=0 (drains). 'Commit on the threshold, act on release: permissions, audio, navigation and anything sent wait for the lift.' Durations: 700 ms (site .hold); 733 (Lalita Mirror gate bars, +0.075/55 ms); 750 (Living Rite embodiment crossing); 900 (Instrument Light carve minimum; Living Axis fall to source); 1000 (seal the Ceremony); 1100 (Being hold ring; the Point's gate burst; the rope); 1250 (Lalita Mirror door); 1300 (Threshold cross; Still Point stage); 1400 (rewind); 1500 (Story beat); 1900 (deck shuffle); 2200 (die throw); 2300 up / 620 down (Compose release); 2600 (Seven Gates lay down); 2800 (Child Space); 2900 / 750 (The Turning); 4000 (Archetype Profile ring; Sakshi Pause inhale); 4200 (the Light, draw one line in); 5000 (Bindu Immersive Act 0, one breath). Bands: commit 0.7-1.3 s; ceremonial 1.1-2.9 s with drain; >3 s only where the hold is the act. Early release drains DOWN_MS 620-750 ms or 0.04/frame; 'Never a failure sound, never a jolt back to zero.' Haptics: tick at press (8 ms web); continuous ramp 0.15 → 0.6, sharpness ≈0.3; one latch at completion (12 ms web / medium impact native); no buzz on early release.
